content:
Let  
\[
t=\log_{2026}x.
\]
Then \(x=2026^t\), so
\[
x^{\log_{2026}x}=x^t=(2026^t)^t=2026^{t^2}.
\]
Thus the equation becomes
\[
\sqrt[20]{2026^{t^2}}=26\cdot 2026^t,
\]
or
\[
2026^{t^2/20}=26\cdot 2026^t.
\]
Taking \(\log_{2026}\) of both sides gives
\[
\frac{t^2}{20}=t+\log_{2026}26.
\]
Multiply by 20:
\[
t^2-20t-20\log_{2026}26=0.
\]
The two possible values of \(t\) satisfy
\[
t_1+t_2=20
\]
by Vieta’s formulas. Therefore the product of the corresponding positive \(x\)-values is
\[
x_1x_2=2026^{t_1}\cdot 2026^{t_2}=2026^{t_1+t_2}=2026^{20}.
\]
Now factor:
\[
2026=2\cdot 1013,
\]
so
\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot 1013^{20}.
\]
The number of positive divisors is
\[
(20+1)(20+1)=21^2=441.
\]
\[
\boxed{441}
\]
